description.value: You reach into a creature's connection to the Force and clamp down on it. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it can't cast Force or Tech powers, nor benefit from Force points or Tech points, for the duration. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 4
